method: CI lexical census of authored JavaScript/TypeScript. It reports direct screenshot calls, singular Playwright mask and maskColor options, plural masks metadata, and imports/calls of shared capture helpers. Every mask signal is bound by owner, option kind, occurrence ordinal, normalized exact value, and classification; line and excerpt remain report locations only. The inventory records bounded source purpose and gate ownership, not runtime evaluation or blanket capture approval.
